questions.q: The Constitution of India came into force on:
questions.explanation: It was adopted on 26 November 1949 and came into force on 26 January 1950, now celebrated as Republic Day.

questions.q: How many Fundamental Duties are listed in Article 51A of the Constitution?
questions.explanation: The 42nd Amendment (1976) added 10 duties and the 86th Amendment (2002) added an 11th.

questions.q: Which is the longest river flowing within India?
questions.explanation: The Ganga is the longest river in India. The Godavari is the longest river in peninsular India.

questions.q: Where is the central office of the Reserve Bank of India?
questions.explanation: The RBI's central office has been in Mumbai since 1937.

questions.q: Article 21 of the Constitution deals with:
options: Protection of life and personal liberty
questions.explanation: Article 21: no person shall be deprived of life or personal liberty except according to procedure established by law.

questions.q: Which is the largest planet in the Solar System?
questions.explanation: Jupiter is the largest planet. Its mass is more than twice that of all other planets combined.

questions.q: What is the chemical formula of common salt?
questions.explanation: Common salt is sodium chloride, NaCl.

questions.q: Who appoints the Governor of a state?
questions.explanation: Under Article 155, the Governor is appointed by the President.

questions.q: Deficiency of which vitamin causes scurvy?
questions.explanation: Scurvy is caused by a lack of vitamin C (ascorbic acid).

questions.q: The Tropic of Cancer does NOT pass through which of these states?
questions.explanation: It passes through Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura and Mizoram, but not Odisha.

questions.q: What is the SI unit of force?
questions.explanation: Force is measured in newtons (N). 1 N = 1 kg·m/s².

questions.q: The repo rate is the rate at which:
questions.explanation: Repo rate is the rate at which the RBI lends short-term funds to commercial banks against government securities.

questions.q: Who presides over a joint sitting of the two Houses of Parliament?
questions.explanation: Under Article 108, the Speaker of the Lok Sabha presides over a joint sitting.

questions.q: What is the minimum age to be elected President of India?
questions.explanation: Article 58 requires a presidential candidate to be at least 35 years old.

questions.q: Which is the largest Indian state by area?
questions.explanation: Rajasthan is the largest state by area, about 3.42 lakh km².

questions.q: Which gas makes up most of the Earth's atmosphere?
questions.explanation: Nitrogen is about 78% of the atmosphere and oxygen about 21%.

questions.q: The Battle of Plassey was fought in:
questions.explanation: Robert Clive defeated Siraj-ud-Daulah at Plassey in 1757.

questions.q: Kaziranga National Park, known for the one-horned rhinoceros, is in:
questions.explanation: Kaziranga is in Assam and is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

questions.q: What does NABARD stand for?
options: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development
National Board for Agricultural Research and Development
National Bank for Agro and Rural Deposits
National Bureau of Agriculture and Rural Development
questions.explanation: NABARD (National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development) was set up in 1982 as the apex body for rural credit.

questions.q: What is the currency of Japan?
questions.explanation: Japan's currency is the yen. The yuan is China's and the won is South Korea's.
